name: Lavender Love Letter
source:
Welcome to the city of Lavendaria, where love begins with a confession written on paper. Everyone who lives here has his own story, from the happy to the unpleasant.

You play as Michael Von, a man who just arrived in this city and got lost while looking for your apartment. Fortunately, you are assisted by a woman named Lycha Magenta. She is maybe looked like apathetic woman, but behind it all she is very care with what you do. Later, there will be an incident that makes you have to marry someone you "don't  love" yet.
translation:
Welcome to the city of Lavendaria, where love begins with a confession written on paper. Everyone who lives here has his own story, from the happy to the unpleasant.

You play as Michael Von, a man who just arrived in this city and got lost while looking for your apartment. Fortunately, you are assisted by a woman named Lycha Magenta. She is maybe looked like apathetic woman, but behind it all she is very care with what you do. Later, there will be an incident that makes you have to marry someone you "don't  love" yet.
